description: This file contains JSON serialization utilities and custom JSON converters for Orleans core types, including classes for serializing/deserializing IPAddress, GrainId, ActivationId, and other Orleans-specific types, enabling JSON serialization compatible with Orleans serialization requirements.

classes.name: OrleansJsonSerializer
classes.description: Utility class for configuring JsonSerializerSettings for Orleans types, providing serialization and deserialization functionalities.

classes.name: IPAddressConverter
classes.description: JsonConverter for serializing and deserializing IPAddress objects.

classes.name: GrainIdConverter
classes.description: JsonConverter for serializing and deserializing GrainId objects.

classes.name: ActivationIdConverter
classes.description: JsonConverter for serializing and deserializing ActivationId objects.

classes.name: SiloAddressJsonConverter
classes.description: JsonConverter for serializing and deserializing SiloAddress objects.

classes.name: MembershipVersionJsonConverter
classes.description: JsonConverter for serializing and deserializing MembershipVersion objects.

classes.name: UniqueKeyConverter
classes.description: JsonConverter for serializing and deserializing UniqueKey objects.

classes.name: IPEndPointConverter
classes.description: JsonConverter for serializing and deserializing IPEndPoint objects.

classes.name: GrainReferenceJsonConverter
classes.description: JsonConverter for serializing and deserializing GrainReference objects.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes JSON string into an object of the expected type using configured settings.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes an object into a JSON string using configured settings.
